answers.core: If it's possible to have this functionality live in an asset, I think that would probably also be fine. I don't have extensive knowledge of the project architecture, but I assumed that this proposed change would be quite simple to implement.
answers.workaround: The enhancement itself will be integrated into the source of the editor and difficult to avoid. However, the _functionality_ of the enhancement will be guarded by the proposed menu options, and the default value would replicate the functionality currently in Godot, meaning it would have no impact on users who do not choose to navigate to the menu and enable this feature.

title: Add support for absolute grid snapping in the 3D editor
